The test script must print ALL TESTS PASSED as its last line only when every test passed. def parse_csv_line(line):
    if line == '':
        return ['']
    fields = []
    i = 0
    n = len(line)
    while i < n:
        if line[i] == '"':
            # quoted field
            i += 1  # skip opening quote
            field_chars = []
            while i < n:
                if line[i] == '"':
                    if i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == '"':
                        field_chars.append('"')
                        i += 2
                    else:
                        # closing quote
                        i += 1
                        # after closing quote must be comma or end of line
                        if i < n and line[i] == ',':
                            i += 1
                        elif i == n:
                            pass  # end of line, fine
                        else:
                            raise ValueError(f"Expected comma or end of line after closing quote, got {line[i]!r}")
                        break
                else:
                    field_chars.append(line[i])
                    i += 1
            else:
                # reached end without closing quote
                raise ValueError("Unquoted field has no closing quote")
            fields.append(''.join(field_chars))
        else:
            # unquoted field: runs until comma or end of line
            # must not contain double quote
            if '"' in line[i:]:
                raise ValueError("Double quote in unquoted field")
            # find next comma
            j = line.find(',', i)
            if j == -1:
                fields.append(line[i:])
                i = n
            else:
                fields.append(line[i:j])
                i = j + 1
    return fields
